steps.title: Analyze Build Error Logs

steps.description: Validate package properties inside AndroidManifest.xml for namespace correctness.

steps.title: Validate 3D Drawing Surface
steps.description: Inspect ThreeDCalculatorView and ThreeDLoaderView drawing commands for compatibility.

steps.title: Check Audio Synth DSP Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure the dynamic SoundSynth PCM buffer generator compiles correctly.

steps.title: Verify Expression Parser Mechanics
steps.description: Validate the custom recursive-descent math parser in MainActivity.

steps.title: Review Local Storage SharedPreferences
steps.description: Ensure history persistence behaves correctly inside HistoryManager.

steps.title: Check Gradle Build Configuration
steps.description: Verify Java 8 compatibility and SDK level 34 settings.

steps.title: Verify Resource Integrity
steps.description: Ensure the icon reference and system light/dark styles are consistent.

steps.title: Building ThreeD Calculator
steps.description: Compile, assemble, run internal automated diagnostics, build project binaries, and output the debug packages.
